description: A fiscal year's congressional budget-resolution targets next to what the U.S. Treasury actually reported: revenues, total outlays, the implied deficit, and outlays by budget function, each with budget, actual and the difference. Totals are compared on the on-budget basis the resolutions use (Social Security's off-budget part excluded), with unified totals beside them. Actuals come from the Monthly Treasury Statement (net outlays, nominal dollars) and say whether the year is complete; the budget side says whether the resolution was adopted. A year with no resolution still returns the actuals plus a named reason for the missing budget side. Use for "how did FY2025 outlays compare to the budget resolution?", "defense spending vs budget plan". Sources: U.S. Congress (as published by the U.S. Government Publishing Office) and U.S. Treasury.

adopted_only.description: true: compare only against a resolution adopted by both chambers.

fiscal_year.description: Federal fiscal year (Oct-Sep) to compare, e.g. 2025.

function.description: Limit to one budget function (substring or three-digit code). Totals are always included.
